paper_title: Shuttle Between the Instructions and the Parameters of Large Language   Models
caption: : The induction performance of SHIP and SFT on SNI with respect to the number of observed samples. The accuracy is the average accuracy over all seen and unseen tasks.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the induction performance of two models, SHIP and vanilla SFT, in terms of accuracy over a range of observed samples. The plot's x-axis is labeled "observed samples" and has a linear scale, with values ranging from 1 to 6. The y-axis is labeled "accuracy" and also has a linear scale, with values ranging from 0.3 to 0.8. The green line representing SHIP starts at approximately 0.81 at observed sample 1 and ends at 0.84 at observed sample 6. The blue line representing vanilla SFT starts at approximately 0.35 at observed sample 1 and increases steadily to approximately 0.44 at observed sample 6.
